digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify / External Integration Tests workflow
propositions: Complete real-Pandoc corpus replay consumes 184+ seconds on macOS critical path in Gerrit Verify and should be moved to External Integration Tests workflow

ADR 0095 mandates every conversion assertion use the real Pandoc binary; a narrowing superseding ADR is required to move full corpus replay to external job while preserving production renderer invariants
External Integration Tests workflow is currently Ubuntu-only and requires future implementation to add ubuntu-latest and macos-latest matrix arms for dedicated pandoc-corpus-replay job
Three representative live corpus bodies (code_arrow, table, prose) plus compact provenance probes remain in Gerrit Verify with all existing assertion classes against committed deterministic outputs
Pandoc version drift and platform-specific binary fingerprints must fail fast with deterministic fixture regeneration documented and paired A/B evidence required at implementation
